👀 Adorable Big-Eyed Girl’s Emoji Lab

Adorable Big-Eyed Girl has been studying all kinds of
emojis lately! 🔍✨
But… she seems to have run into a little problem. 🤔

Take a close look at the event image and put your
eagle eyes to the test! Can you find the two identical
emojis? 👀💕

📅 Event Time
Now - September 28

🎮 How to Participate
1. Carefully check all the emojis in the event image.
2. Find the two emojis that are exactly the same.
3. Comment below with your answer.
Please make sure to include:
In-Game Name
Server ID

🎁 Event Rewards
10 lucky players who meet the event requirements will
be randomly selected. Each winner will receive a
$4.99 reward! 🎉

Come help Adorable Big-Eyed Girl complete her emoji
research! 🔍👀
Let’s see who can find the correct answer the fastest!
